entities.summary: Oluwatoyin (Toyin) Asojo is Associate Director for Inclusive Excellence at the Dartmouth Cancer Center. She was previously an associate professor and chair of the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Hampton University and an associate professor of pediatrics-tropical medicine at the Baylor College of Medicine. Asojo works at the interface of math, chemistry, biology, and computation. She is a crystallographer with an interest in the structural studies of proteins from neglected tropical disease pathogens.
